info.name: Tripora API
info.description: Tripora backend API — V1 (Auth + User Profile/Admin + Destination + Travel Guide + Trip Planner + Wishlist + Review + Blog + Notification + Report) + V2 (Provider + Property + Room + Room Inventory + Booking). Import together with tripora-api.postman_environment.json.

request.description: Creates a new User (role USER). Sets refreshToken as an HTTP-Only cookie. 409 if the email is already registered.
Sets refreshToken as an HTTP-Only cookie. 401 if email/password is wrong.
Reads refreshToken from the HTTP-Only cookie (Postman keeps cookies automatically after Login). Rotates the refresh token and returns a new accessToken. 401 if missing/expired/revoked.
Revokes the current refreshToken and clears the cookie.
Requires Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>. 401 if missing/expired token.
Yeu cau role ADMIN. Filter bang q (contains email/firstName/lastName). Khong tra passwordHash.

Yeu cau role ADMIN. status: ACTIVE | INACTIVE | BANNED. 400 neu tu doi status cua chinh minh. User bi BANNED/INACTIVE se khong the dang nhap (login tra 403) va refresh token bi thu hoi (refresh tra 401).
Public. Filter bằng q (contains name) / country. Trả { items, pagination }.
Public. 404 nếu không tồn tại/đã xoá.

Tru `available`/cong `booked` cua TourSchedule atomic trong 1 transaction (chong overbooking). 400 neu Tour chua mo lich ngay do, 409 neu khong du cho. `numberOfPeople` khong duoc vuot `maxParticipants` cua Tour (400 neu vuot). **[V6]** Booking tao ra o trang thai `PENDING_PAYMENT` (khong con `CONFIRMED` ngay), response tra ve `{ booking, checkoutUrl }` — redirect sang `checkoutUrl` (Stripe Checkout) de hoan tat thanh toan, webhook xac nhan xong Booking moi chuyen `CONFIRMED`. **[V6 vong 2]** `couponCode` (optional) — ma giam gia hop le se giam truc tiep vao so tien charge qua Stripe (400 ngay neu ma sai/het han/het luot); khong nhap ma se tu ap Promotion dang chay khop nhat neu co.

item.name: Create Flight Booking (Passenger Info -> Booking -> E-ticket)

request.description: Yeu cau dang nhap (bat ky USER nao). seatIds lay tu GET /flight-seats (buoc Select Seat) — moi seatId ung voi 1 passenger cung vi tri trong mang. Flip tung dong FlightSeat AVAILABLE->BOOKED atomic trong 1 transaction (409 neu 1 trong cac ghe khong con AVAILABLE — SOLD_OUT), 400 neu chon ghe BUSINESS ma lich bay chua co businessPrice. totalPrice tinh tu economyPrice/businessPrice cua FlightSchedule tai thoi diem dat (snapshot). **[V6]** Booking tao ra o trang thai `PENDING_PAYMENT` (khong con `CONFIRMED` ngay), response tra ve `{ booking, checkoutUrl }` — redirect sang `checkoutUrl` (Stripe Checkout) de hoan tat thanh toan, webhook xac nhan xong Booking moi chuyen `CONFIRMED` va E-ticket (kem passengers) moi xem day du duoc qua GET /flight-bookings/mine. **[V6 vong 2]** `couponCode` (optional) — mirror Tour Booking.
Chi chu booking (403 neu khong), chi khi con CONFIRMED va departureDate chua toi (400 neu da bat dau hoac da huy roi). Hoan tra tung ghe da dat ve AVAILABLE atomic.

item.name: Stripe Webhook (Stripe goi thang, khong dung tay)

header.value: (Stripe tu ky, khong tu dien tay duoc)

request.description: Stripe goi thang khi Checkout Session hoan tat/het han/that bai — khong goi qua Postman thuc te duoc vi can chu ky HMAC that (`stripe-signature`) ma chi Stripe tao ra. Dung Stripe CLI `stripe listen --forward-to <baseUrl>/payments/webhook` de test that. Verify chu ky qua `stripe.webhooks.constructEvent` (backend/CLAUDE.md muc 3 'Payment Verify') — sai chu ky bi tu choi ngay, khong doi status Payment/Booking.
Yeu cau dang nhap + la chu Payment do (403 neu khong). Dung de Frontend poll trang thai sau khi redirect ve tu Stripe Checkout (PENDING/SUCCESS/FAILED).

Yeu cau dang nhap + la chu Payment do. Tao lai 1 Checkout Session Stripe moi cho dung Payment da FAILED (hoac PENDING nhung khach bam thu lai) — 400 neu Payment da SUCCESS. Booking van con PENDING_PAYMENT nen van hop le de thanh toan tiep, mien con trong han BOOKING_PAYMENT_EXPIRY_MINUTES.

Yeu cau dang nhap (bat ky USER nao). Multipart/form-data, field 'file'. Chi nhan jpg/jpeg/png/webp, toi da 5MB (400 neu vi pham). Upload len Cloudinary (folder 'tripora'), tra ve { url }. Dung chung cho moi noi can anh (Property/Room images, Provider logo...), khong rieng cho 1 entity nao.
